title: Why defensibility is the hook for VC data center investments
excerpt: AI’s infrastructure boom has already been running at a staggering pace, and this week it received a further $500 billion vote of confidence from Wall Street’...
content_html:
Leah Hodgson

Fri, August 14, 2026 at 11:37 AM MDT 5 min read

AI's infrastructure boom has already been running at a staggering pace, and this week it received a further $500 billion vote of confidence from Wall Street's biggest names.

Nvidia signed memorandums of understanding with six of the world's largest asset managers and investment banks, including Blackstone, KKR and Apollo Global Management, to raise the capital to fund what it is calling "AI factories."

While not guaranteed, the deal signals that demand for AI infrastructure is showing no signs of slowing. VCs are backing that same buildout by funding the semiconductors that power it.

Global funding for AI and machine learning semiconductors reached $14.1 billion in the first half of the year, according to PitchBook's latest AI Report, on track to surpass last year's annual total by almost 50%. Both Q1 and Q2 this year are the two highest quarters on record for investment. Deal count is also projected to land above 2025's figure.

"AI is not just a tool, it redefines technology," Sriram Viswanathan, founding managing partner of deep tech VC firm Celesta Capital, said. "If you accept the notion that everything is going to change, the question is, what is the tip of the spear? That is semiconductors, because that powers everything."

That conviction is rooted in the belief that AI's growth trajectory faces an increasing number of bottlenecks that can't be solved by software improvements alone. Hardware, on the other hand, offers something increasingly rare elsewhere in AI: real defensibility.

Bottlenecks fuel bets

The scale of the semiconductor opportunity is hard for any investor to ignore. According to a base-case estimate from McKinsey in March, the industry could reach $1.6 trillion in revenue by the end of the decade.

It is also a market that is becoming increasingly valuable as AI faces more constraints, according to Viswanathan. The demand for computers significantly outweighs the supply. AI data center demand is set to exceed capacity by 2027, and one-fifth of planned projects could be delayed due to a lack of grid connections.

He argues that AI faces limitations at every layer of the advanced computing stack, from the processor and the power that feeds it to memory and the network that connects the chips. These constraints are where VCs are finding opportunities for returns, leading to significant deals.

In March, Ayar Labs closed a $500 million Series E to speed up data center transmission by using light to connect GPUs and chips. Last week, Olix, which uses lasers to move data between large clusters of chips faster, raised a $312 million Series B. XCENA, which develops computational memory architectures that reduce data bottlenecks, secured $135 million for its Series B in May.

content_html_zh:
利亚·霍奇森

2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五上午 11:37 MDT 阅读 5 分钟

人工智能的基础设施热潮已经以惊人的速度发展，本周它又获得了来自华尔街大佬们的 5000 亿美元的信任票。

Nvidia 与 Blackstone、KKR 和 Apollo Global Management 等全球六家最大的资产管理公司和投资银行签署了谅解备忘录，以筹集资金为其所谓的“人工智能工厂”提供资金。

虽然不能保证，但该交易表明对人工智能基础设施的需求没有显示出放缓的迹象。 风险投资公司也通过为为其提供动力的半导体提供资金来支持同样的建设。

根据 PitchBook 最新的人工智能报告，今年上半年全球人工智能和机器学习半导体的融资额达到 141 亿美元，有望超过去年的年度总额近 50%。 今年第一季度和第二季度都是有记录以来投资最高的两个季度。 预计交易数量也将超过 2025 年的数字。

深度科技风险投资公司 Celesta Capital 的创始管理合伙人斯里拉姆·维斯瓦纳坦 (Sriram Viswanathan) 表示：“人工智能不仅仅是一种工具，它重新定义了技术。” “如果你接受一切都会改变的观念，那么问题是，矛尖是什么？ 这就是半导体，因为它为一切提供动力。”

这一信念植根于这样的信念：人工智能的增长轨迹面临着越来越多的瓶颈，而这些瓶颈无法仅通过软件改进来解决。 另一方面，硬件提供了人工智能其他领域越来越罕见的东西：真正的防御性。

瓶颈燃料赌注

半导体机遇的规模对于任何投资者来说都难以忽视。 根据麦肯锡 3 月份的基本情况估计，到本十年末，该行业的收入可能达到 1.6 万亿美元。

维斯瓦纳坦表示，随着人工智能面临更多限制，这个市场也变得越来越有价值。 对计算机的需求大大超过了供应。 到 2027 年，人工智能数据中心的需求将超过容量，五分之一的计划项目可能因缺乏电网连接而推迟。

他认为，人工智能在先进计算堆栈的每一层都面临着限制，从处理器和为其供电的电源到内存和连接芯片的网络。 这些限制正是风险投资公司寻找回报机会、促成重大交易的地方。

今年 3 月，Ayar Labs 完成了 5 亿美元的 E 轮融资，旨在通过光连接 GPU 和芯片来加速数据中心传输。 上周，Olix 筹集了 3.12 亿美元的 B 轮融资，该公司利用激光器在大型芯片簇之间更快地传输数据。 XCENA 致力于开发可减少数据瓶颈的计算内存架构，5 月份的 B 轮融资获得了 1.35 亿美元的融资。
